fields.label: Title
fields.name: case_title
fields.default_value: Case Study

fields.label: Description
fields.name: case_desc
fields.default_value:
Project goal:

A large door manufacturer, primarily operating in the US market, approached us for CGI services to support the launch of a new line of entrance doors with enhanced protection against natural disasters and break-ins.

Our approach:

Initially, the client approached us to develop the visual design of the product itself. For this purpose, we created around 56 different door models placed in various environments.

After the final concept was approved, we worked under NDA to prepare full presentation materials — including presentations, brochures, 3D product visualizations, detailed renders of hardware and hinges, close-ups, delivered the full 3D model, and produced several video clips to showcase the unique features of the doors.

The final goal was to prepare assets for the website, social media and product catalogs.  Within this task, we delivered approximately 248 product visualizations on white background and in realistic environments.
